contract_basis: Verified payloads only; FUTURE entries carry agreed empty-state copy. See field-map.md for the full table and live.schema.json for payload schemas.

live.json_path: GET /api/v1/events → events[] {id, store_id, device_id, camera_id, wire_id, track_id, direction, event_timestamp, received_at}
live.source: Tripwire crossing persistence (durably stored, survives rollup timing)
live.privacy: Session-scoped numeric track_id; no identity ever stored.

live.json_path: GET /api/v1/live → queue_alert_active; per queue: GET /api/v1/live/snapshot → queues[].alert_active
live.ui_rule: Red badge + suggested action copy while true; calms automatically when the queue drains past the threshold+grace.

future.why_future: No alert rule is deployed; producing one before the rule exists would fabricate alerts.
future.empty_state_copy: Dwell alerts activate when the alert rule is configured for your zones — aggregation fields (zone dwell) are live already.

future.why_future: No safety model on this node.
future.empty_state_copy: No safety model on this edge node. We will not render fabricated alerts; fall/crowd-surge will only come from a dedicated model.

available_live.json_path: GET /api/v1/analytics/products → categories[] {category, viewers, detections, total_dwell_seconds, avg_dwell_seconds, windows}; GET /api/v1/live → products_top
available_live.privacy: Open-vocab display categories — explicitly not POS SKUs and never revenue.
available_live.note: Historical rows exist and are dated (e.g., handbag: 47,305 viewers / 187,487 detections from earlier runs).

partial.json_path: GET /api/v1/analytics/demographics → demographics {sample_size, k_anonymity, age_bands[], gender_split[], publishable, suppressed_count}
partial.source: Redaction-only face boxes → INT8 age/gender ONNX → k≥10 anonymity gate
partial.status_reason: Model loads and runs; display suppressed while sample_size < k (verified output: sample_size 0, publishable false).
partial.privacy: k-anonymity k=10 verified; suppressed cohorts never render; no face identity stored, ever.
partial.empty_state_copy: Cohort counts unlock after ≥10 anonymous samples inside the privacy window (k-anonymity). The real model runs — we suppress below the threshold by design.

partial.source: Pose + head-pose enrichment over redacted face boxes
partial.status_reason: Enrichment tier is config-gated and currently off in fast perf mode; fields are honest zeros (verified).
partial.privacy: Head-pose aggregates only; no gaze-per-person persisted.
partial.empty_state_copy: Attention metrics (facing/phone/groups) activate with pose + head-pose enrichment on this node. Rows show honest zeros today so the queue and footfall numbers are never contaminated.

partial.status_reason: Producer exists in rollup schema; needs enrichment enablement, verified zeros otherwise.
partial.empty_state_copy: Groups activate with the enrichment tier — proximity clustering counts people-in-company once enabled.
Phone-usage rate reports real ratios once the enrichment tier is enabled — never estimated.
